decisions.statement: Every file the recomputation moves lands in one write.
A file already saying what the reading says is not written again.
A run moving no file writes nothing and commits nothing.
The completion each character has is read from the file beside that character.
A character with no completion file beside it counts as having no completion.
A completion file holding no JSON object refuses the recomputation.
A refusal names the completion file it read.
A run that refuses leaves every progress file as it was.
A character's line is labelled by that character's first name.
A task the pages placed no file for is passed over.
Every reach outside this module is an argument the caller may hand in.
The account whose completion is read is the account the tasks name.

definition: the recomputed progress of every task landed as one commit
